description: Quality levels for Knowledge Packages. Official release SHOULD declare a target level.

levels.name: Bronze
levels.summary: Structurally valid package with complete required metadata and identifiers.

levels.name: Silver
levels.summary: Bronze plus complete documentation and strong reference coverage.

levels.name: Gold
levels.summary: Silver plus examples/tests for the package type and near-complete references.
requires: examples or tests present when package_type is analytical, interpretation, or report

levels.name: Platinum
levels.summary: Gold plus Golden Dataset stage pass (or recorded N/A) and zero unacknowledged release warnings.
requires: golden_dataset_validation is pass or not_applicable with waiver
PVP-RELEASE pass with zero unacknowledged warnings
